'''Tenman Tenjingu''' (天満天神宮) is a [[Shinto shrine]] in [[Japan]] ([[Tenmangū|Tenmangu]]). There are 11 [[Religious corporation|Religious corporations]] with this name.

* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Ichikawa City)]] - A shrine located at the site of the former Ōno Castle in Ōnocho, Ichikawa City, Chiba Prefecture, and is an outer shrine of [[Honkō-ji Temple]]. It is not a religious corporation.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Minobu Town)]] – Located in Koseki, Minobu Town, Nanko District, Yamanashi Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Shimada City)]] – Located in Itachi, Shimada City, Shizuoka Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Nishiizu Town)]] – Located in Naka, Nishiizu Town, Kamo District, Shizuoka Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Ōzu City)]] – Located in Narunouko, Ōzu City, Ehime Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Odate, Kochi City)]] – Located in Odate, Kochi City, Kochi Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Fukuicho, Kochi City)]] – Located in Fukuicho, Kochi City, Kochi Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Asai, Tosa City)]] – Located in Asai, Tosa City, Kochi Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Yōishi, Tosa City)]] – Located in Yōishi, Tosa City, Kochi Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Inocho, Edagawa Ikedani)]] – Located in Ikeno, Edagawa, Inocho, Kochi Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Inocho, Edagawa Fujigase)]] – Located in Fujigase, Edagawa, Inocho, Kochi Prefecture.
* [[Tenman Tenjingu (Hidaka Village)]] – Located in Motomura, Hidaka Village, Takaoka District, Kochi Prefecture.
